_readme: Config for organization/scripts/quality-sensors.mjs (estate). Four of the ten sensed dimensions are
PATH-dependent: without this file they scan NOTHING and the run says so. This package was running
with no config at all, so CE-01, CE-05, CE-08 and RC-09 were silently unscanned while the scorecard
still read as a pass on the rest.
wiringGlobs IS DELIBERATELY EMPTY, and that is not the same as absent. The sensor treats a missing
key as 'not configured' and skips the dimension; an empty list means 'nothing here is wiring', so
EVERY file is held to the rule. That is the correct posture for a shared package: a design system
reads no environment and constructs no database client, ever. If one of those findings appears, the
answer is to move the code out of this package, not to add a glob here.
CE-01 is the dimension this package exists for. A shared component carrying a hardcoded colour
defeats the point of having a design system, so componentGlobs must cover everything under
